title: Ordinary direct image on strict coefficient systems
statement: For every prime $\ell$, finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, scheme morphism $f:X\to Y$, and coefficient comparison $C$ of [def-pur-completed-pushforward-models], the ordinary data OrdinaryStrictImageData of [def-pur-completed-coefficient-ordinary-strict-image-data] are nonempty. This is the ordinary, section-normalized strict-system construction, without any derived data or limit comparison.

proof.text: Construct the actual direct image at each constant quotient ring using SheafOfModules.pushforward and constantPush. Transpose naturality of the sheafification unit to prove constantPush_naturality. The identity-section pushforwardComp and pushforwardCongr comparisons commute this direct image with coefficientRestriction. Apply the level functors to successive transitions and component maps; naturality proves the system morphism squares, functor laws hold componentwise, and additivity is checked at evaluations.

Construct the quotient ring equivalence induced by ULift.ringEquiv and sheafify it to finiteCoefficientIso. Lift the supplied finiteIso homomorphism through the fully faithful forgetful functor from commutative ring sheaves to ring sheaves. Sheafification hom-ext and surjectivity of the quotient map show that finiteIso_generator determines this lift uniquely, so the supplied isomorphism equals finiteCoefficientIso. Naturality of constantPush then proves modelStructure_finite. Its pushforward composition comparison gives pushEvaluation, with identity sections.

Compose the supplied target systemEvaluation, pushEvaluation, finiteSquare.ordinary, and the inverse of source systemEvaluation to form diagramEvaluation. Each has identity sections; for the inverse this follows by applying its inverse-hom equation and the identity for its hom. The supplied source and target systemTransition identities and the explicitly constructed image transition make the successor squares commute on sections. NatTrans.ofOpSequence extends this to all degree maps. Each component is an isomorphism, so asIso and NatIso.ofComponents assemble diagramIso. Naturality in input systems follows directly from the naturality of diagramEvaluation. Assemble these constructed data into OrdinaryStrictImageData.
